description: Events whose title slot is empty (0xFF) in the PAL release and that no code starts or completes (or only cut content does).
source: Event research shared at https://claude.ai/artifact/LKgNAn4dYnArqoQtcupY48 (searches of setEventStarted, awardEventProgress and the event flags in every executable and overlay of the PAL and Japanese releases, and of scripts and room objects). Dead means the search found no code that starts or completes the event; it is not proof that nothing else does.
